goal: Measure effective pollinator dependency directly in the same tagged Izu populations rather than inferring dependency from floral form, family or realized interaction breadth.
required_linked_channels: single-visit pollen deposition on previously unvisited receptive stigmas
effective_service_definition: observed visit bouts per monitored flower-hour multiplied by background-adjusted mean single-visit conspecific pollen deposition for the same visitor group and population
core_reproductive_ratios: bagged_autonomous capsule set / supplemental_outcross capsule set
open_pollinated capsule set / supplemental_outcross capsule set
why_no_fixed_sample_threshold_yet: SVD and treatment dispersion must come from a pilot or external species-specific calibration. Structural completion is intentionally separated from precision/power adequacy.

pilot_precision_state_machine.next_gate: collect linked pilot rows from multiple independent plants
lock biologically meaningful absolute CI half-width and confidence before confirmatory expansion
calculate approximate independent-plant replication from pilot between-plant SD
stress-test site/time replication, expected loss, visitor availability and hierarchical model by simulation before final field lock

comparator_rule: Choose comparators from direct interaction/reproductive evidence and phenological feasibility; do not assign specialist/generalist classes from floral syndrome labels.
high_dependency_endpoint_rule: A high-dependency endpoint must be demonstrated by direct effective-pollinator data or an external prespecified calibration; it is not preassigned from corolla morphology.
survivorship_rule: Non-establishment, hybrid replacement and interaction rewiring remain response modes and must not be excluded solely because a pure same-lineage island survivor is unavailable.
service_output_guard: Official CLI output withholds background-adjusted SVD, rate-weighted effective service and service share when a visitor group lacks a no-visit SVD control.
claim_boundary: The direct field panel can estimate contemporary per-visit effectiveness, rate-weighted effective service and reproductive dependence in sampled populations. It does not by itself identify historical Bombus loss, historical selection, self-compatibility, realized selfing, or a causal Oshima-Toshima boundary effect.
